title: Agent-assisted incident response
description: DevOps workflow design: CloudWatch alerts drive a bounded agent loop (EventBridge → SQS → Step Functions/LangGraph) for read-only investigation, incident summary, and optional code-fix proposals on an isolated branch. Automated CI gates and a reviewer agent feed a pull request; production merge and deploy require explicit engineer approval. Low-confidence or exhausted retries escalate to ServiceNow with full context. Safety: least-privilege access, log redaction, and untrusted log input.
env: AWS CloudWatch, EventBridge, SQS, Lambda, ECS, Step Functions, LangGraph, AI agents (Analyzer, Code-fix, Reviewer), GitHub PRs, CI (tests, lint, security), ServiceNow, Python
